edits.before: Let the Father's love carry Let Mercy Speak Restoring Compassion into one faithful step today.

edits.before: Let the Father's love carry Return to Love That Sends You into one faithful step today.

edits.before: Let the Father's love carry Yield to Covenant Mercy into one faithful step today.

edits.reason: Keeps Genesis 1:25's Maker and ordered-life frame while preserving correction without shame.

edits.before: Let the Father's love carry Anchor the Father's Welcome into one faithful step today.

edits.before: Let the Father's love carry Discover Beloved Identity into one faithful step today.
edits.after: Rest this Saturday Sabbath from self-measuring; beloved identity is received before the week speaks again.
edits.reason: Keeps the Adventist seventh-day Sabbath frame and Genesis 1:27's received image-bearing identity.
